# Doll

> A local narrator. https://doll.sociallydead.me/

Doll speaks a markdown page, and she sings when the page asks. Qt Quick is the studio. Vulkan draws the doll. Doll Script is MAGIC.

## Pages

- [Home](https://doll.sociallydead.me/): the voice, the three views, how she runs, and Contribute
- [The room](https://doll.sociallydead.me/room/): one skeleton, one skin, and the company
- [Doll Script](https://doll.sociallydead.me/script/): names, events, listeners, classes and interfaces, try and finally, the short names beside LSL, page marks, singing, and the picture modules
